title: 第二章 目标：收服30个兽夫 ×
slug: 恶毒雌性玩的花兽世大佬排队跪
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

什么四个人？

这是打麻将，可以一起来了吗？

大哥你先把裤子穿上，再说这种虎狼之词行不行！

不对，这里可能确实是虎狼世界。

姜枝终于意识到，她穿越了，而且魂穿了一个反派人物。

震惊到瞳目震颤，姜枝表面却只能强撑镇定，偷偷抬头看对面的人。

这一看，姜枝才发现，苍凛虽然坐在那里没动，但全身肌肉都是绷紧的。

那像是一种习惯性的戒备。

尤其她刚才滚下床的时候，他眼神里甚至掠过一丝极淡的凶意。

和唱跳第一名的流量爱豆完全不一样好吗。

姜枝心里忽然有点不是滋味。

而苍凛似乎察觉到了她的视线，脊背下意识绷得更紧，像是已经习惯了下一秒被命令、被摆弄、甚至被再次折磨。

然后垂下眼，低声问：

“您要弄坏我吗？”

姜枝：“……”

这话听着怎么更吓人了。

她一个正经兽医，没有这种嗜好。

以前在宠物店看见熊孩子揪猫尾巴都姜枝想报警，更别说这种纯纯神经病式虐待。

就在这时，一道声音忽然在姜枝脑子里响起：

【喵——兽世系统绑定成功。~o(=∩ω∩=)m】

【宿主：姜枝喵】

【您眼前的兽人是苍凛，狼族兽人，您的第一兽夫，关系破裂中。】

穿越果然有系统，标配她懂，但这系统难道是一只喵？

【是的喵，系统喵将陪伴宿主强娶30个顶级兽男】

声音很可爱，目标很变态。

30个？

Page (1/3)

What four people?

This is mahjong, can we come together?

Brother, can you please put your pants on first before you say such sarcastic words?

No, this may indeed be the world of tigers and wolves.

Jiang Zhi finally realized that she had traveled through time and had passed through a villain in her soul.

Shocked to the point that his pupils were trembling, Jiang Zhi could only maintain his composure on the surface and secretly raised his head to look at the person opposite.

Looking at it, Jiang Zhi realized that although Cang Lin was sitting there and not moving, the muscles all over his body were tense.

It was like a habitual alertness.

Especially when she rolled out of bed just now, there was even a faint hint of murderous intent in his eyes.

Isn't it completely different from the popular idol who is number one in singing and dancing?

Jiang Zhi suddenly felt a little uncomfortable.

Cang Lin seemed to be aware of her gaze, and his back subconsciously tensed up, as if he was used to being ordered, manipulated, or even tortured again in the next second.

Then he lowered his eyes and asked in a low voice:

"Are you going to break me?"

Jiang Zhi: "..."

This sounds even more scary.

She is a serious veterinarian and has no such hobby.

I used to want to call the police when I saw a naughty child pulling a cat's tail in a pet store, let alone such purely psychotic abuse.

At this moment, a voice suddenly sounded in Jiang Zhi's head:

[Meow—The Beast World system was successfully bound.~o(=∩ω∩=)m】

[Host: Jiang Zhimiao]

[The orc in front of you is Cang Lin, a wolf orc, your first orc, and the relationship is breaking down.】

Sure enough, there is a system for time travel, and she understands the standard configuration, but is this system a cat?

[Yes, Meow, System Meow will accompany the host to forcibly marry 30 top beast men]

The voice is cute and the target is perverted.

30?
